summary: First Western Financial Inc filed an 8-K to disclose board authorization of a $5 million common stock repurchase plan, effective June 12, 2026, for one year. The Federal Reserve issued a non-objection on April 29, 2026. Repurchases may occur in open market, privately negotiated transactions, or via Rule 10b5-1 plans. No specific price per share or premium is stated. The plan is discretionary, with no obligation to acquire a set dollar amount. This is a routine share buyback—a capital return event. Watch for execution pace and any trading plan adoption; minimal risk-arb angle due to open-market nature.
